title: Puttu
description: Steamed cylinders of coarse rice flour layered with fresh coconut, a soft traditional Kerala breakfast usually eaten with kadala curry.
steps: Dry roast the rice flour in a pan on low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until it feels warm and dry, then cool.
Mix the salt into the flour and sprinkle the water in small amounts, rubbing with your fingers until the flour looks like damp breadcrumbs that hold when pressed lightly.
Fill a puttu maker or cylindrical mould in layers, starting with a spoon of grated coconut, then flour, then coconut again, finishing with coconut.
Steam over boiling water for 6 to 8 minutes until steam pushes out of the top.
Push out the cylinder gently and serve hot with kadala curry or banana and sugar.
